What is Visual Basic .NET and how do you create a Hello World program?

Visual Basic (VB.NET) is a type-safe, object-oriented language on the .NET platform. It features natural English-like syntax, strong IDE integration with Visual Studio, and full access to the .NET ecosystem. VB.NET and C# are largely interchangeable on .NET.

```vb
' HelloWorld.vb
Module Program
    Sub Main(args As String())
        Console.WriteLine("Hello, World!")
        Console.WriteLine("Hello, {0}!", "Visual Basic")
    End Sub
End Module
```

```bash
dotnet new console --language VB -o HelloApp
cd HelloApp
dotnet run
```

How do variables, types, and strings work in VB.NET?

```vb
' Basic types
Dim name As String = "Alice"
Dim age As Integer = 30
Dim pi As Double = 3.14159
Dim flag As Boolean = True
Dim ch As Char = "A"c
Dim big As Long = 9_000_000_000L
Dim dec As Decimal = 19.99D

' Type inference
Dim inferred = "inferred string"   ' String
Dim inferredNum = 42               ' Integer

' Nothing (null equivalent)
Dim obj As Object = Nothing

' Nullable types
Dim nullInt As Integer? = Nothing
If nullInt.HasValue Then Console.WriteLine(nullInt.Value)

' Constants
Const MaxItems As Integer = 100

' String operations
Dim s As String = "Hello, World!"
Console.WriteLine(s.Length)          ' 13
Console.WriteLine(s.ToUpper())
Console.WriteLine(s.Substring(0, 5)) ' Hello
Console.WriteLine(s.Contains("World"))
Console.WriteLine(s.Replace("World", "VB"))

' String interpolation
Dim greeting = $"Hello, {name}! You are {age} years old."

' Type conversions
Dim n As Integer = CInt("42")
Dim d As Double = CDbl("3.14")
Dim str As String = CStr(42)

' Safe parsing
Dim parsed As Integer
If Integer.TryParse("123", parsed) Then Console.WriteLine(parsed)
```

How does control flow work in VB.NET? Show If, Select Case, and loops.

```vb
Dim x As Integer = 10

' If / ElseIf / Else
If x > 0 Then
    Console.WriteLine("positive")
ElseIf x = 0 Then
    Console.WriteLine("zero")
Else
    Console.WriteLine("negative")
End If

' Single-line If
If x > 0 Then Console.WriteLine("pos")

' Inline ternary
Dim label = If(x > 0, "positive", "non-positive")   ' If() is ternary in VB

' Select Case (VB switch)
Select Case day
    Case "Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday"
        Console.WriteLine("Weekday")
    Case "Saturday", "Sunday"
        Console.WriteLine("Weekend")
    Case Else
        Console.WriteLine("Unknown")
End Select

' Select Case with ranges
Select Case score
    Case 90 To 100 : Console.WriteLine("A")
    Case 80 To 89  : Console.WriteLine("B")
    Case Else      : Console.WriteLine("F")
End Select

' For...Next
For i As Integer = 1 To 10
    Console.Write(i & " ")
Next

For i As Integer = 0 To 10 Step 2   ' step
    Console.Write(i & " ")
Next

' For Each
For Each fruit In {"apple", "banana", "cherry"}
    Console.WriteLine(fruit)
Next

' While / Do loops
While n < 100 : n *= 2 : End While
Do While count < 5 : count += 1 : Loop
Do Until count = 10 : count += 1 : Loop

' Exit For / Continue For
For i As Integer = 1 To 10
    If i = 5 Then Exit For
    If i Mod 2 = 0 Then Continue For
    Console.Write(i & " ")   ' prints odd numbers
Next
```

How do arrays and collections (List, Dictionary, Queue, Stack) work in VB.NET?

```vb
Imports System.Collections.Generic

' Array
Dim arr(4) As Integer          ' 5 elements (0..4)
Dim arr2() As Integer = {1, 2, 3, 4, 5}
Dim matrix(,) As Integer = {{1, 2}, {3, 4}}

arr2(0) = 10
Console.WriteLine(arr2.Length)   ' 5
Array.Sort(arr2)
Array.Reverse(arr2)
Console.WriteLine(matrix(1, 0)) ' 3

' List(Of T) — dynamic array
Dim list As New List(Of String)
list.Add("Alice")
list.Add("Bob")
list.Remove("Bob")
list.Insert(0, "Zero")
Console.WriteLine(list.Count)
Console.WriteLine(list.Contains("Alice"))
list.Sort()
For Each item In list : Console.WriteLine(item) : Next

' Dictionary(Of K, V)
Dim dict As New Dictionary(Of String, Integer)
dict("Alice") = 30
dict.Add("Carol", 35)
dict.Remove("Bob")
If dict.ContainsKey("Alice") Then Console.WriteLine(dict("Alice"))
For Each kvp In dict
    Console.WriteLine($"{kvp.Key}: {kvp.Value}")
Next

' Queue and Stack
Dim queue As New Queue(Of String)
queue.Enqueue("first") : queue.Enqueue("second")
Console.WriteLine(queue.Dequeue())   ' first (FIFO)

Dim stack As New Stack(Of Integer)
stack.Push(1) : stack.Push(2) : stack.Push(3)
Console.WriteLine(stack.Pop())       ' 3 (LIFO)
```

How do Subs, Functions, ByRef, lambdas, and optional parameters work in VB.NET?

```vb
' Sub — no return value
Sub Greet(name As String, Optional greeting As String = "Hello")
    Console.WriteLine($"{greeting}, {name}!")
End Sub

' Function — returns value
Function Add(a As Integer, b As Integer) As Integer
    Return a + b
End Function

' ByRef — pass by reference (modify caller's variable)
Sub Swap(ByRef a As Integer, ByRef b As Integer)
    Dim temp = a
    a = b
    b = temp
End Sub

Dim x = 10, y = 20
Swap(x, y)
Console.WriteLine($"x={x}, y={y}")   ' x=20, y=10

' ParamArray — variable number of arguments
Function Sum(ParamArray nums() As Integer) As Integer
    Dim total = 0
    For Each n In nums : total += n : Next
    Return total
End Function
Console.WriteLine(Sum(1, 2, 3, 4, 5))   ' 15

' Overloading
Function Max(a As Integer, b As Integer) As Integer
    Return If(a > b, a, b)
End Function
Function Max(a As Double, b As Double) As Double
    Return If(a > b, a, b)
End Function

' Lambda expressions
Dim square As Func(Of Integer, Integer) = Function(x) x * x
Dim isEven As Func(Of Integer, Boolean) = Function(x) x Mod 2 = 0
Dim greetL As Action(Of String) = Sub(name) Console.WriteLine($"Hi {name}")

Console.WriteLine(square(5))   ' 25
greetL("Carol")
```

How do classes, inheritance, interfaces, and abstract classes work in VB.NET?

```vb
Public Class Animal
    Private _name As String
    Public Property Age As Integer   ' auto-property

    Public Sub New(name As String, sound As String)
        _name = name
    End Sub

    ' Overridable = virtual in C#
    Public Overridable Function Speak() As String
        Return $"{_name} speaks"
    End Function

    Public Overrides Function ToString() As String
        Return $"Animal({_name})"
    End Function
End Class

Public Class Dog
    Inherits Animal    ' Inherits = extends
    Public Property Breed As String

    Public Sub New(name As String, breed As String)
        MyBase.New(name, "Woof")   ' call parent constructor
        Breed = breed
    End Sub

    Public Overrides Function Speak() As String
        Return MyBase.Speak() & "!"  ' call parent method
    End Function
End Class

' Interface
Public Interface IPrintable
    Sub PrintDescription()
    Function PrettyDescription() As String
End Interface

' MustInherit = abstract class
Public MustInherit Class Shape
    Public MustOverride ReadOnly Property Area As Double     ' abstract
    Public Sub PrintInfo()
        Console.WriteLine($"Area: {Area:F2}")
    End Sub
End Class

Public Class Circle
    Inherits Shape
    Private _r As Double
    Public Sub New(r As Double) : _r = r : End Sub
    Public Overrides ReadOnly Property Area As Double
        Get : Return Math.PI * _r * _r : End Get
    End Property
End Class
```

How do exceptions and file I/O work in VB.NET?

```vb
Imports System.IO

' Try/Catch/Finally
Try
    Dim result = 10 / 0
Catch ex As DivideByZeroException
    Console.WriteLine($"Math error: {ex.Message}")
Catch ex As Exception
    Console.WriteLine($"Error: {ex.Message}")
Finally
    Console.WriteLine("Always runs")
End Try

' Throw
Throw New ArgumentException("Invalid argument", "paramName")

' File operations
Dim path = "test.txt"

' Write
File.WriteAllText(path, "Hello, World!" & Environment.NewLine)
File.AppendAllText(path, "Second line" & Environment.NewLine)

' Read
Dim content = File.ReadAllText(path)
Dim lines() = File.ReadAllLines(path)
For Each line In lines : Console.WriteLine(line) : Next

' StreamWriter / StreamReader (Using = auto-close)
Using writer As New StreamWriter(path, append:=True)
    writer.WriteLine("StreamWriter line")
End Using

Using reader As New StreamReader(path)
    Dim line = reader.ReadLine()
    While line IsNot Nothing
        Console.WriteLine(line)
        line = reader.ReadLine()
    End While
End Using

' Path operations
Dim fullPath = Path.Combine("C:\Users", "Alice", "file.txt")
Console.WriteLine(Path.GetFileName(fullPath))    ' file.txt
Console.WriteLine(Path.GetExtension(fullPath))   ' .txt
File.Delete(path)
```

How does LINQ work in VB.NET? Show both query syntax and method syntax.

```vb
Imports System.Linq

Dim people As New List(Of Person) From {
    New Person With {.Name = "Alice", .Age = 30, .City = "NYC"},
    New Person With {.Name = "Bob",   .Age = 25, .City = "LA"},
    New Person With {.Name = "Carol", .Age = 35, .City = "NYC"}
}

' LINQ Query Syntax (SQL-like)
Dim nycPeople = From p In people
                Where p.City = "NYC"
                Order By p.Age
                Select p.Name

For Each name In nycPeople : Console.WriteLine(name) : Next

' LINQ Method Syntax
Dim avgAge = people.Average(Function(p) p.Age)
Dim oldest = people.OrderByDescending(Function(p) p.Age).First()

' Grouping
Dim grouped = people.GroupBy(Function(p) p.City)
For Each group In grouped
    Console.WriteLine($"City: {group.Key}")
    For Each p In group : Console.WriteLine($"  {p.Name}") : Next
Next

' LINQ on arrays/sequences
Dim numbers = Enumerable.Range(1, 20).ToArray()
Dim evens = numbers.Where(Function(n) n Mod 2 = 0)
Dim doubled = numbers.Select(Function(n) n * 2).ToArray()
Dim top5 = numbers.OrderByDescending(Function(n) n).Take(5)
Dim total = numbers.Sum()

' Anonymous types
Dim nameAge = From p In people
              Select New With {p.Name, p.Age}

' Tuples (ValueTuple)
Dim named = (Count:=5, Name:="Alice")
Console.WriteLine(named.Count)   ' 5
Console.WriteLine(named.Name)    ' Alice
```
